newsitem.title: ITALY: Reuters, Mondadori Internet site wins award.
newsitem.headline: Reuters, Mondadori Internet site wins award.

text.p: Time on Line, a new Internet service started by Italian publishing group Mondadori's New Media division and international news and information organisation Reuters Holdings Plc, has won an award for the best journalistic Internet site, Mondadori said in a statement.
Mondadori said Time on Line won an "Emma" (European Multi Media Award), presented at the Frankfurt book fair this week for the business/commercial category.

The experimental, free English language information service, which started in late July, offers an edited selection of daily world news, graphics and photographs of top stories of the day produced by Reuters and is divided in sections by subject and country.
The service can be accessed by the following address -
Mondadori said the award was particularly significant as Time on Line was a finalist for the award with a site of Corbis Corp, one of the most renowned companies in the sector in the United States.
Mondadori is part of the Fininvest SpA media group of former prime minister Silvio Berlusconi.

Mondadori added that its New Media division also won an Emma for the category interactive movies category with its CD-ROM "Blindness", the first film game which can also be played by unsighted people.
